Moment Bicycles Saturday Point Loma Ride

San Diego, CA · Old Town · Road

No-drop

Moment Bicycles Saturday Point Loma Ride is a road group ride in San Diego, CA. It rolls every Saturday at 8:30 am from Moment Bicycles. About 23 or 39 miles, two groups; a second group scoops up anyone dropped from the first. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: two groups; a second group scoops up anyone dropped from the first. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @momentbicycles the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Moment Bicycles Saturday Point Loma Ride group ride

Saturday shop ride through Point Loma, Harbor Island, downtown, Balboa Park and Mission Bay, with a short and a long option. Two groups roll so nobody rides alone. The shop also runs Tuesday and Thursday 6:30 am hill repeats and a rotating Sunday route.
